location.name: The sluice

view.text: A footbridge over a black sluice. The grating below, the stair beyond, Bakery Row behind.

location.asset: You look down. The sluice keeps what it has. No face turns. Harbour water, with a lid on.
Iron bars where the sluice meets the harbour, and black water through them. Nothing you can see from up here.
What the baker saw. A board peg wedged in the grating, the kind that holds a boat's name. The letters cut in it are VOSS.
location.ending: You read his hour to the sluice. The black water rises to the boards, and a pale face turns up where the water was empty.
